typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportDate as string (),
	ExportFileExcel as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	OverrideReportDate as timestamp (),
	ReportDate as timestamp (),
	TemplateFile as string ()
}

source(output(
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CALL_LIST_CD as string,
		CALL_LIST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as timestamp,
		MEMBER_PHONENUMBER as string,
		PHONESOURCE_CD as string,
		HH_MEMBER as string,
		MARKET_CD as string,
		PRODUCT_CD as string,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION as string,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE as string,
		UNIT_JOB as string,
		LOAD_DATE as date,
		LOAD_RULE_CD as string,
		LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date,
		ATTEMPTS as integer,
		CALL_DATE as timestamp,
		PHONENUMBER_CALLED as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DISPOSITIONGROUP as string,
		DISPOSITIONGROUPDESCRIPTION as string,
		PHONESOURCE_CD1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	CL.CALLLIST_CD AS CALL_LIST_CD, 	CL.CALLLIST_NAME AS CALL_LIST_NAME, 	M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBER_ID, 	M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME, 	M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME, 	M.MEMBER_BIRTH_DT AS MEMBER_DOB, 	MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE AS MEMBER_PHONENUMBER, 	PS.PHONESOURCE_CD, 	HHM.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS HH_MEMBER, 	M.MEMBER_MCAID_MARKET_CD AS MARKET_CD, 	M.MEMBER_MCAID_PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT_CD, 	M.MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION, 	M.MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE, 	UJ.UNITJOB_NAME AS UNIT_JOB, 	CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) AS LOAD_DATE, 	MINLCR.CALLLISTRULE_CD AS LOAD_RULE_CD, 	MINLCR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC AS LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION, 	CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) AS SCRUB_DATE, 	COALESCE(ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD,IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_CD) AS SCRUB_RULE_CD, 	COALESCE(ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC,IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) AS SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION, 	TA.ATTEMPT_NUM AS ATTEMPTS, 	C.CALL_CALLDATETIME AS CALL_DATE, 	C.CALL_PHONENUMBER AS PHONENUMBER_CALLED, 	TA.CALL_PHONESOURCE_CD AS PHONESOURCE_CD1, 	DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD AS DISPOSITIONCODE, 	DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION AS DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION, 	DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD AS DISPOSITIONGROUP, 	DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_DESCRIPTION AS DISPOSITIONGROUPDESCRIPTION  FROM [dbo].[PDS_RPT_DMCCU_SCRUBLIST_MEMBERS] T 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON T.MAX_CM_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 		AND T.TIMES_SENT_TO_DIALER > 0 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON T.MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER MINCM ON MINCM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = T.MIN_CM_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE MINCD ON MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = MINCM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE MINLCR ON MINLCR.CALLLISTRULE_IID = MINCM.CALLLISTMASTER_LOAD_CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE IGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON T.MEMBERPHONE_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_PHONESOURCE PS ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONESOURCE_IID = PS.PHONESOURCE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBER HHM ON HHM.MEMBER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_HOH_MEMBER_IID 		AND HHM.MEMBER_IID <> M.MEMBER_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID = UJ.UNITJOB_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[PDS_RPT_DMCCU_SCRUBLIST_ATTEMPTS] TA ON TA.MEMBER_IID = T.MEMBER_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_IID = TA.CALL_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES CDO ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CDO.CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CDO.CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONGROUP DG ON DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID = COALESCE(CDO.CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES_DISPOSITIONCODE_DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID) ORDER BY M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,TA.ATTEMPT_NUM',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSDMCCURemovals
PDSDMCCURemovals derive(LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		MEMBER_PHONENUMBER_Unicode = MEMBER_PHONENUMBER,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_Unicode = DISPOSITIONCODE,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD_Unicode = SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		DISPOSITIONGROUPDESCRIPTION_Unicode = DISPOSITIONGROUPDESCRIPTION,
		MEMBER_ID_Unicode = MEMBER_ID,
		MARKET_CD_Unicode = MARKET_CD,
		PHONESOURCE_CD1_Unicode = PHONESOURCE_CD1,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME_Unicode = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		UNIT_JOB_Unicode = UNIT_JOB,
		CALL_LIST_NAME_Unicode = CALL_LIST_NAME,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME_Unicode = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		PRODUCT_CD_Unicode = PRODUCT_CD,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE_Unicode = MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE,
		HH_MEMBER_Unicode = HH_MEMBER,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		DISPOSITIONGROUP_Unicode = DISPOSITIONGROUP,
		LOAD_RULE_CD_Unicode = LOAD_RULE_CD,
		PHONESOURCE_CD_Unicode = PHONESOURCE_CD,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION_Unicode = MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION,
		PHONENUMBER_CALLED_Unicode = PHONENUMBER_CALLED,
		CALL_LIST_CD_Unicode = CALL_LIST_CD) ~> RemovalsDataConversion
